scan.description: Identical scene to optix_baseline (box at x=3, center_value ~2.5), plus a gaussian noise element (stddev 0.1). The falsifiable check: optix_baseline's own center_value_stddev is ~0 (deterministic, same box every frame) -- if this world's stddev isn't clearly above that, the noise element isn't actually being applied by rmagine_optix_sensor_system.
